home.title: A trusted campus platform for reporting and resolving issues.
home.subtitle: CivicSense helps students and staff report campus issues quickly and track progress securely until resolution.
home.step1Body: Share what happened, where it happened, and optionally add a photo.
home.step2Body: The platform suggests category, priority, and department for faster action.
home.step3Body: Use your complaint ID and secret token to follow every status update.
home.categoriesBody: Infrastructure, sanitation, hostels, academics, IT, transport, safety, and more.
home.trustPrivacy: No account is required. Your complaint is submitted without personal profile data.
home.trustAccessible: Designed for clear reading, keyboard access, and high-contrast status indicators.
home.trustBilingual: Available in English and Assamese across reporting and tracking workflows.

submit.title: Report an issue
submit.intro: Tell us what's wrong on campus. We'll help get it to the right department.

title.label: What's the issue?
title.hint: Write a short title describing the problem.
title.placeholder: e.g. Broken lights near the library

description.label: Describe the issue
description.hint: Share what happened so the right team can act quickly.
description.placeholder: What happened? Where did it happen? Any additional details...

location.label: Where is the issue?
location.hint: Include the building, floor, room, or nearby landmark.

category.label: Issue category
category.hint: Optional. Leave this on auto-detect and AI will suggest the best category and department.

image.label: Add a photo
image.hint: Help us understand the issue better.
image.disabled: Image upload is currently disabled by server configuration. You can still submit your complaint.
image.tooLarge: This image is larger than {{max}} MB.
image.wrongType: Please choose a supported image format.

language.label: Communication language
language.hint: We'll use this language for updates and AI-generated summaries.

validation.titleLength: Title must be between 5 and 150 characters.
validation.descriptionLength: Description must be between 20 and 5000 characters.
validation.locationLength: Location must be between 2 and 120 characters.

success.title: Complaint submitted successfully
success.intro: Save both values below. You need them to track your complaint later.
success.warning: This tracking token is shown only once and cannot be recovered later. Save it now.

track.title: Track a complaint
track.intro: Enter your complaint ID and secret tracking token to view the latest status.
track.notFound: No complaint matched this ID and token combination. Please check and try again.

result.title: Complaint tracking details
result.subtitle: This view shows only public complaint information.
result.rejectedInfo: This complaint is closed as rejected. If needed, submit a new complaint with updated details.

admin.label: Admin
admin.aiFlaggedReviewInfo: Groq AI flagged these as possible spam or duplicates. Review each complaint before taking action.
admin.noFlagged: No complaints have been flagged as spam or duplicates.
admin.noFlaggedInfo: New AI-flagged complaints will appear here.
admin.title: Title
admin.tryRemoving: Try removing a filter or searching for something else.

detail.noAi: No AI analysis is available for this complaint. You can set the category, priority, and department manually below.
detail.statusInfo: Status changes are recorded in the history and visible to the complainant.
detail.triageInfo: Category and priority are shown to the complainant on the tracking page.
detail.notesInfo: Only administrators can see these notes. They are never shown on the public tracking page.
detail.notePlaceholder: Add a note for other administrators…

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please wait a while and try again.

footer.text: CivicSense is a campus grievance and issue-management platform designed for transparent, accountable resolution.
